name: Thief Simulator VR: Richie R. Street
summary:
🗺️ Explore a completely new scene, even bigger than Greenview
🏡 Visit new houses - more interesting, luxurious and much, much bigger!
✅ Complete new missions and get deeper into the story with Vinny as your guide
👮 Face new challenges - guards and security systems
🏎️ Hijack and disassembly luxurious cars
🚨 Enjoy new mini-games: car keys cloning, alarms deactivation
👩‍💼 Meet new NPCs - new tenants and police officers are now more challenging and ready to end your thieving odyssey!
🔑 Unlock new achiev
